fields.why: No design is named; every rate and comparison is at country level, which meets the brief's 'unit of analysis is a group' definition of ecologic, but there is no group-level exposure-outcome analysis, so omitting it (A, who flagged it in notes) is also defensible.

brief_issues: 'Ecologic' is defined only by the unit of analysis; it could say whether descriptive country- or state-level rate comparisons without an exposure qualify.
